text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen, and Tokai Teio—the racer Sweep Tosho's peer looks up to—is running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a Grand Prix race that serves as a fitting stage to determine the greatest runner of the year. Can Sweep Tosho cast her magic again?
